faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by All India Institute of Medical Sciences Kalyani (AIIMS Kalyani) for various project-based posts funded under ICMR.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Kalyani Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available across positions like Project Research Scientist-I (Medical), Project Technical Support-III, and Project Technical Support-II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Kalyani Jobs 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for these positions is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly online through the provided Google Form link and official instructions mentioned in the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligible qualifications for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: Candidates possessing an MBBS or BDS degree from a recognized university are eligible to apply for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Technical Support-III post will receive a salary of Rs. 28,000/- plus 30% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for any of the posts announced by AIIMS Kalyani.

faq.question: Q8. What is the maximum age limit for Project Technical Support-II?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Project Technical Support-II post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an offline MCQ test or interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I access the official website of AIIMS Kalyani?
faq.answer: You can visit the official AIIMS Kalyani website at https://aiimskalyani.edu.in for all official updates and detailed notifications.
